records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Welcome to Wrenfield! Your workspace is ready. A good first step is to create your first project and invite a teammate.

If anything's unclear, just reply here.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Customer explicitly deferred evaluation by a week [email:3ea2e499], leaving little of the 8-day window; no project, no invite, no key milestone at day 6 despite welcome email [email:8075477a], kickoff [calendar:bc66bf4b] and check-in [email:4030ffed]. Handoff churn [slack:14e824e3] adds risk.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks for being straight with me — totally fair to take another week to decide, and I won't crowd you in the meantime.

One thing that often helps the evaluation: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so seeing one real project in place tends to make the fit question much easier to answer. If it's useful, I'm happy to help you set up that first project whenever you're ready — just reply and I'll pick it up from there.

Otherwise I'll check back in next week.

Best,
Nadia
